GUIDED STEPS
1
Sit comfortably. Feet flat, hands resting. Let your eyes soften or close.
2
Take three slow breaths — inhale through the nose, exhale a little longer than the inhale.
3
Bring attention to the crown of your head. Notice any sensation — warmth, pressure, nothing at all is fine.
4
Slowly travel down: face, jaw, shoulders, chest, belly, hips, legs, feet. About 30 seconds at each stop.
5
Rest in the whole body for a final breath. Open your eyes when you're ready.
